profitTTM gap targets, enumerated 2026-08-13. profitTTM needs EIGHT quarters (last 4 + the 4 a year earlier), so it reaches back two years and catches far more of the IPO cohort than the one-year factors. 597 cells were open on the Nifty-500 matrix 2020-01..2026-06.
⚠️ I FIRST CALLED THE BIGGEST CLASS 'not fillable' AND THAT WAS WRONG — the user made me reconfirm. 'The quarter predates our oldest row' is a fact about OUR data, not the world: aggregators carry pre-listing quarters from the prospectus (POLICYBZR listed 2021-11 and MC holds it from 2020-12). Probed: MC holds 35 of the 217 needed pre-listing quarters (16%) across 15 symbols, INCLUDING KPITTECH — the very example used to argue it was impossible. Never infer absence from our own gaps (§57/§63).
Route: the gated aggregator sweep, unchanged —
  agg_sweep.py --cells scripts/ttm_gap_targets.json --sites mc,tl --out /tmp/t.json
  agg_fy_check.py --props /tmp/t.json --out-props /tmp/final.json     (Gate A5)
  the con-fallback discriminator (§85) on every patC proposal
  apply_agg_pat_fills.py --props /tmp/final.json --apply    then run it TWICE, 2nd pass 0
Then rebake docs/coverage and verify LIVE, not the log.
